notes.title: Sker Ritual Episode Three: Sewers of the Dead OUT NOW
notes.content:
The wait is over Sker Islanders, Sker Ritual's Episode Three: Sewers of the Dead is OUT NOW! Descend into the Sewers of the Dead, the Sker Island underground lair and home of The Stranger! 

[h3][b]EXPLORE THE BRAND-NEW MAP [/b][/h3]

Delve into the Sewers of the Dead, the Sker Island underground lair and home of The Stranger. Navigate through tunnels of infestation where the Quiet Ones are not your only enemy. Watch where you step as The Stranger's swarm of rats are under the control of his glaring eyes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/eb32dc057ea32a87d3f235e93cb30d05ce5fedae.gif[/img]

[h3][b] FACE CHALLENGING NEW ENEMIES [/b][/h3]

[b]GUTO (Elite Enemy #1)[/b]

Run, run as fast as you can because in a flash the Guto will be upon you. These agile elites dash at alarming speed and in unpredictable directions, making every twist and turn through the dank underground a possible threat.  

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/63ad69d7bdb815c0ae68fadb41af040279ba7603.gif[/img]

[b]DEMON HAG (Elite Enemy #2) [/b]

Now she’s here...now she’s not...beware the teleporting Demon Hag and her searing laser beams that shoot out from her gruesome, green eyes. Rising from the dirt and murk, this elite is a deadly combination of the Witch and the Mariner.  

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/6d659aa250634524057866a24780296ef4242a9b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]NEW OBJECTIVES [/b][/h3]

Unlock areas of the map with the help of a mind-controlled Quiet One. Escort the lumbering enemy turned ally safely and be sure to keep feeding it points if you want it to walk faster.  Plus, send Quiet Ones into a spin! Set in the gory, gorged-out chests of Quiet Ones, shoot the rat in the hamster wheel to get them going.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/2b6baa6c6afef9a444c8e3a11a2342b262c1840b.gif[/img]
 
[h3][b]NEW WEAPONS [/b][/h3]

[b]THE PLAGUE - Special Weapon [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/f21092ab2a13f7cc2c96186a62bce8333a7aafaf.gif[/img]

The Plague, Sker Ritual’s answer to Pest Control. Discharge bombs with this multi-grenade launcher that releases plumes of purple gas. Damage enemies and objects alike to progress your objectives.  

[b]CROSSBOW [/b]

Load up! This crossbow shoots a fan of 3 arrows and will slaughter through 3 enemies in turn. The crossbow will also be available in all levels. 

[b]PIONEER’S AXE [/b]

This infamously powerful melee weapon possesses a radius slash damage to hack through multiple targets. The Pioneer’s Axe will also be available in all levels. 

[h3][b]BEAT THE NEW BOSS [/b][/h3]

Find yourself transported into the warped mind of The Stranger. Avoid the sight of his relentless scanning eyes, but don’t get caught or be prepared to face swarms of rodents whilst still combatting waves of Quiet Ones. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/fa2b2de0900f86083bb1703865da5fd0cd6b7d65.gif[/img]

[h3][b]NEW FIXES AND UPDATES [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 25 new, free Sker Pass rewards 
[*] New Achievements  
[*] New achievement icons 
[*] Localisation for Episode 2 & Episode 3 
[*] Updated Aim down Sight position for The Howler 
[/list]
[h3][b]UPCOMING FOR EPISODE 3 [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Name of the level and difficulty in the end screen and scoreboard screen  
[*] Notification when you kill a main boss 
[*] Possibly adding weapon stats when buying in-game. 
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/pVm7NjqjxK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/74292309910fbb3947731c0a63b6d6c4fea5966d.jpg[/img][/url]

Experience Sker Ritual's Episode Three: Sewers of the Dead with our amazing Discord community. Let us know your initial reactions, feedback and form new Sker Squads to take on the Quiet Ones together. 

Stay tuned for information on our upcoming updates, patches as well as additional DLC & bundled content!

notes.title: Play Sker Ritual in the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33855640/761da51b304833990a67437f833f0bbb2d54cba6.gif[/img]

We can finally reveal the timed exclusive demo for Sker Ritual in the Steam Next Fest event which runs in tandem with Geoff Keighley’s Summer Game Fest from June 13th-20th! The demo will enable 1-4 players to team up online and face Sker Island’s [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1492070/announcements/detail/3222896627775920704]Quiet Ones[/url] and their more powerful cohabitants, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1492070/announcements/detail/3127189423510586254]The Elites[/url], in a first-person round-based survival shooter.

After customising their character’s horror-themed masks, players can jump into Solo, Private or Quick Play online matchmaking for one map, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1492070/announcements/detail/3127189423510586254]The Cursed Lands of Lavernock[/url]. The demo will include a sample of our Story Objectives and gain full access to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1492070/announcements/detail/3127189423510590375]The Laughing Policeman’s[/url] shop and the steampunk-inspired Magnificent Munitions Upgrade Station.

The demo represents the end of Alpha development and will switch to Beta before launching on Steam Early Access later this Summer. The alpha demo will be limited to 30 minutes per game, with an unlimited amount of replays. We’re excited to listen to the community’s feedback and encourage all players to join the [url=https://discord.gg/Pb2uFYRB7P]Sker Ritual Discord[/url] server to be a part of the journey and connect with others in the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33855640/74292309910fbb3947731c0a63b6d6c4fea5966d.jpg[/img]

COMING SOON IN BETA…

- Boss Events and Top Tier enemies
- Additional Elites with unique powers
- Additional maps
- Additional guns, steampunk upgrades, masks, and further customisation
- Complex Objectives and Easter eggs
- Advanced functionality for the unannounced ‘Miracles’ system
- Improved mechanics for the unannounced revive system

notes.title: Sneak Peek #3 - Weapons and Upgrades
notes.content:
[h3]ROLL UP! ROLL UP! 

GET YOUR MAGNIFICENT MUNITIONS AT THE LAUGHING POLICEMAN! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/0475358b4e3e71aafba3e6afdd43562b21cf866b.gif[/img]

[b]Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the show![/b]

Introducing the maniacal, the mechanical, the malevolent, The Magnificent Munitions at [b]The Laughing Policeman![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/c391298bde0c127dd36dc188af39c912ff376f85.jpg[/img]

Get your guns, ammo, and more at[b] The Laughing Policeman’s[/b] booth at various locations in the world. 

[b]The Laughing Policemen[/b] has an arsenal filled with weapons of the highest calibre perfect for battling your way through the Quiet Ones with or without your friends.  

Some of the base weapons at [b]The Laughing Policeman’s Magnificent Munitions[/b] include a wide variety of weapons, including assault rifles, single or double-barrel shotguns, pistols and revolvers, hunting rifles and more! Choose wisely you can only hold two weapons at a time! 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/3a0fef4d2e0ac6c11da4fe4f2169d8d3b605f9b6.jpg[/img]

Short on ammo? Stock up at his [b]Ammo Blammo[/b] machines and never get caught short between the waves of Quiet Ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/8a41c1109b53476f3017756b4d4587e77ed70d13.jpg[/img]

Be sure to be on the lookout for [b]The Laughing Policeman’s Super Charger[/b], but remember it’s location, there’s only one in [b]"The Cursed Lands of Lavernock".[/b] At [b]The Laughing Policeman’s Super Charger[/b], you can upgrade any weapon in your inventory, but for a price...  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/2667ca2d4ce7e678860dc4675cd5538f47fa5e7b.jpg[/img]

A dev team favourite weapon is the double-barrelled shotgun, it’s great for getting up close and personal with the Quiet Ones and causing an absolute bloodbath. Just a regular old shotgun? Well yes, until it meets [b]The Laughing Policeman’s Super Charger[/b]! You’ll be able to upgrade your favourite as long as you can pay the fee...  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/91eca44e1a4650748c3ab04a86fdf55adac5d26b.jpg[/img]

Each upgrade gives the shotgun that extra oomph with enhanced properties with a particular playstyle in-mind which is needed when you get further into the onslaught of waves or the show will end mid-act.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/0181678bfabac6bc8a1b8e6f31cea95d97b22d8a.gif[/img]

[b]The Magnificent Munitions at The Laughing Policeman[/b] is waiting for you, [b]WISHLIST [/b]and [b]FOLLOW [/b]now for your ticket to the show! 

[url=https://www.walesinteractive.com/skerritual]Join our mailing list for exclusive news and rewards[/url]

[b]Let's hear from you[/b]
What do you think? What are you most looking forward to? Any concerns? How would you like our community to grow?

- Wales Interactive Team

notes.title: Developer Update #2 - The Cursed Lands of Lavernock
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

It’s time for a sneak preview and we want to share with you [b]“The Cursed Lands of Lavernock”[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/aac07f45fbad1b8034370bd728315d648dff5e93.jpg[/img]

In [b]"The Cursed Lands of Lavernock"[/b], players will be exploring a new area of Sker Island taking on waves of the "Quiet Ones". From a small fishing village to a secret underground Laboratory, players will have to use their wits to survive the onslaught and complete their mission across an abandoned Cathedral and areas reminiscent of Sker Hotel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/876063abca41f4b9c4532a603bb15c021339332c.jpg[/img]
The long since [b]Abandoned Cathedral[/b] now lays host to ritualistic effigies, with plenty of hidden passages for the Quiet Ones to hunt from 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/8e57247076e7f064d51997a5e0e95a105da8621e.jpg[/img]
[b]The Underground Living Quarters[/b] holds many secrets, twisting and turning, with areas easily overwhelmed if you’re not careful 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/b3d8bb80cc664e07223e4c7c53ccedddf8075a4c.jpg[/img]
[b]The Ancient Farmland [/b]is the perfect place for a respite, or an ambush, watch out for the remains of the Quiet Ones previous victims, you can’t save them now 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/687576a7afdbf6ce62240e05d8b27bea6f61d226.jpg[/img]
[b]The Mysterious Chamber[/b] holds the unknown behind its doors, only the brave can discover 

In Sker Ritual, players will come up against the turned residents of Sker Island. These new "Quiet Ones" pose no real threat to the players but make sure to keep their numbers low or otherwise they will overwhelm you and cause a lot of trouble. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/d58aeb82887af27bea705c5b8210f9281e9d44de.gif[/img]

But be careful some are bigger and badder than ever! [b]The Blazeslinger, Banshee, Mariner, and Phantom[/b] are familiar faces and if you’ve played [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/826940/]Maid of Sker[/url] Challenge mode, you know not to get too close and personal to these elite Quiet Ones. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/312bc2a93c23c753b29eb02a890758ef4d44b585.jpg[/img]

[b]The Blazeslinger[/b] is a little hot-headed, capable of fire attacks at range, but the enemy of my enemy is my friend, wear him down and he might be your best friend. 

Disorientating with her sonic screams [b]The Banshee[/b] has the ability to seemingly appear out of thin air, right behind you. 

Lost to the depths [b]The Mariner[/b], somehow now returned and vengeful, his helmet is his power with laser precision you need to stay out of his line of “sight”  

Evening the playing field, he can’t see you and you can’t see him, [b]The Phantom[/b] aim carefully or you might just miss him but he will find you. 

[url=https://www.walesinteractive.com/skerritual]Join our mailing list for exclusive news and rewards[/url]

[b]Let's hear from you[/b]
What do you think? What are you most looking forward to? Any concerns? How would you like our community to grow?

- Wales Interactive Team

notes.title: New First-Person Shooter Modes Available!
notes.content:
Today we are proud to announce the launch of our challenge modes for the hit survival-horror game Maid of Sker! The new modes showcase a brand new set of game mechanics with the introduction of first-person shooting amongst some new and familiar enemies from Sker Hotel, each buffed with their own unique powerful abilities.

The FPS Challenge Modes are available as a [b]free update on Steam[/b] and to celebrate the release, we're offering new PC players [b]25% off for a limited time[/b] starting today at 6pm GMT!

[b]FEATURING[/b]
[list]
[*] Game modes: The Long Night, Axe of Kindness, Nightmare at the Hotel, In Darkness
[*] Weapons: Felling axe, .357 Magnum, sawn-off double-barrelled shotgun, bolt-action infantry rifle
[*] Enemies: Six enemies patrolling Sker Hotel, some new, some familiar, all with unique powerful abilities 
[*] Leaderboard: Fully supporting Steam Global Leaderboards for each mode
[*] Additional: Support added for PlayStation DualSense Controller
[/list]
Check out the new trailer!

[previewyoutube=6lyGF9poBAc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The Long Night[/b]
· Escape the terror of Sker Hotel.
· An array of weapons at your disposal, featuring a felling axe, .357 Magnum, sawn-off double-barrelled shotgun and a bolt-action infantry rifle.
· Lives are limited, you get three chances only.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33855640/2296739e0d8a1f098765f8d3576ba927ea6545c1.png[/img]
 
[b]Axe of Kindness[/b]
· Get up close and personal with your felling axe!
· A life-saver, receive full health on respawn.
· Lives are limited, you get three chances only.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33855640/3655be847841b6d62e254f63c9b11d665168e972.png[/img]
 
[b]Nightmare at the Hotel[/b]
· A full array of weapons at your disposal.
· Enemies are much stronger and harder to take down.
· Take no chances, respawns are unavailable.
· An extreme challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33855640/50b1897986b330bf7e6e5ad37acf20357ce11ee1.png[/img]
 
[b]In Darkness[/b]
· A full array of weapons, and a flashlight, at your disposal.
· Darkness prevails and health doesn't restore.
· Lives are limited, you get three chances only.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/826940/Maid_of_Sker/

[b]Community Feedback[/b]

We want to hear what you think of the new Challenge Modes to build and improve on this update. If you want to send your anonymous feedback directly to the dev team, fill out our [url=https://forms.gle/cRckXAkWjQ8Maasy9]anonymous feedback form[/url].

Wales Interactive

notes.title: Update & Patch Notes 1.01
notes.content:
Dear fans,

We want to thank you all for the feedback and support you've given since the launch of Maid of Sker yesterday! 

We also want you to know that we're listening to all the comments, reviews, messages and livestream commentaries so we can react and update for the best survival horror experience. Here's everything we have updated since the launch yesterday...

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
- Adjusted Enemy AI detection through walls
- Detection when damaged has been reduced
- Fixed an issue with Hold Breath interrupting itself on rare occasions
- Increased the amount of sound reduction Hold Breath provides

[b]Graphics:[/b]
- TAA sharpening increased for a clearer image (this resolves the slight blur some users are noticing)

[b]Hard Mode:[/b]
- Limited saves increased from 5 to 10
- Balanced the number of enemy AI in earlier levels

[b]Localization:[/b]
- Updated Issues with Arabic Localization
- Updated Issues with Italian Localization

[b]Additional Notes:[/b]
- Maid of Sker features settings to toggle on/off some options including motion blur, chromatic aberration and post-processing. #There is also the option to switch between different anti-aliasing.

[b]WIP[/b]
- We're currently working on editable keybinds and a load of other updates!

notes.title: Make Your Reservation at Sker Hotel on July 28
notes.content:
[h1] Make your Reservation at the Sker Hotel! [/h1]

[b] Join us for the hotel's Grand Re-opening on July 28th, pre-order from July 21st on PC, PS4 and Xbox One. [/b]

At Sker Hotel we offer grotesque views, eerie forest trails, and blood-soaked beds. Be our guest but watch your step, make a sound and the Quiet Ones welcome you.

[previewyoutube=Ewkx5eBlOEs;full]https://youtu.be/yiC7Z7Ih27I [/previewyoutube]

Now you've seen sound devices in use, you've seen the breathing mechanic, the sound-based AI enemies, the inventory system... now we'd like to share a few details on the save system (a common question we receive!)

Yes, you can manually save your game via our Phonographs.

We welcome you to indulge in the use of the Phonographs, a device for the mechanical recording and reproduction of sound. Invented by Thomas Edison, the American inventor who gave us the Electric light bulb, it transitioned into the gramophone, which led to what we still use today — the vinyl record player.

Our Phonographs offer safety, allowing you to catch your breath and save your game, listen to the recordings and unlock the mysteries lurking within the Sker Hotel. 

Upgrade your stay by adding the game to your Steam Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/826940

Now the gates are opening, we will see you soon.

Wales Interactive
